content.thinking: Just a want-shape bug: I used the 2-service SVC for that test (3 columns: A=1,B=2,C=3 — SVC has 3 services!). The `st(5, ...)` expectation had 2 columns but SVC = 3 services. Got rows are 3-wide ✔ correct. Fix the want to 3 columns: match(A) allow over 3 services: rows [[D,D,1],[D,D,D]] with cols A=0,B=1,C=2... wait SVC labels A=1,B=2,C=3 → cols A=0,B=1,C=2. match(A): START --A--> 1. rows [[DENY, DENY, 1],[DENY,DENY,DENY]] accept [F,T] ✔ that's exactly the "got". Fix want.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('tests/test_lifecycle.py').read()
src = src.replace('''], [REJ, st(5, [False, True], [[DENY, 1], [DENY, DENY]]), REJ], limits=lim)''',
'''], [REJ, st(5, [False, True], [[DENY, DENY, 1], [DENY, DENY, DENY]]), REJ], limits=lim)''')
open('tests/test_lifecycle.py','w').write(src)
EOF
timeout 400 python3 tests/test_lifecycle.py 2>&1 | tail -4
